edits.old: this story fixes the three answers it reads and no screen of its own.
edits.new: this story fixes the three answers it reads and no screen of its own. RWB-P1-AD018-APP serves those three reads, RWB-P1-AD018-CON publishes them and RWB-P1-AD018-OPS registers the gateway-bff route and its alerts. The empty, loading, error and no access states: Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-1850). Alert thresholds, panel baselines, channel, replica count, resource size and retention of the monitor are held per environment in the values file; the 15-minute failed-job target of NFR-068 is kept, and the thresholds are confirmed with the operations owner at the wave 4 readiness review.

edits.old: Then no ACE batch, feed or file is started, stopped or rerun
edits.new:
Then no ACE batch, feed or file is started, stopped or rerun

  Scenario: AC7 A replay of a rerun with the same idempotency key is answered as specified (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a rerun request was accepted for a failed Workbench job
    When the same write is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then the answer is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P1-AD018-APP-AC10)

  Scenario: AC8 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the job list answering (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given v_ace_batch_status or the rwb-integration mock does not answer or fails
    When I open the monitor
    Then the affected values show unknown or empty with their own marker and the job list still answers

  Scenario: AC9 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the latest run of a job is RUNNING
    When I rerun it from its run book
    Then the answer is 409 and no second run row is written
    Given the latest run of a job is COMPLETE
    When I rerun it from its run book
    Then the answer is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P1-AD018-APP-AC12)

  Scenario: AC10 An unknown job code on the monitor is refused with MSG-GEN-001 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the job code is not in the job catalogue
    When I open the monitor for that job code
    Then the answer is 404 with MSG-GEN-001 in the error envelope and no partial job list is shown

  Scenario: AC11 A caller holding Platform administration R and not U is refused with MSG-P4-002 and no run row is written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given I hold Platform administration R and not U
    Given a failed Workbench job
    When I rerun it from its run book
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002 and the run log holds no new row

  Scenario: AC12 The provided operations answer 401, 403 and 404 with the error envelope (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given I call a provided operation without a valid login
    When the call is answered
    Then the answer is 401 with the error envelope
    Given I hold Platform administration R and not U
    When I rerun a failed Workbench job
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002
    Given the job code is not in the job catalogue
    When I request the job for that job code
    Then the answer is 404 with the error envelope (NEWAC-RWB-P1-AD018-APP-AC9)
